task_text: Moving grasp handover: A long bar-shaped part is already riding a powered roller conveyor when the episode starts. The left arm must grasp it with its gripper while it is still moving and lift it, then carry it, still moving, through a presentation point. It then hands the part over to the right arm while the part keeps moving: both grippers hold it at the same time, then the left gripper opens wide and lets go while the right one keeps holding it. Finally the right arm must lay the part into a long open slot that slides back and forth on a rail and let go of it while the slot is moving, so that the part lies in the slot while the slot is moving. Phases, in order: moving_pickup: the left gripper grips the part (both left-arm fingers, finger links or pads, are in contact with it) at a moment when the part moves faster than 0.025 m/s; this is recorded once. After that, with the left grip still holding, the part's centre rises above z = 0.21 m.; moving_presentation: while the left gripper still grips the part (both fingers in contact), the part's centre comes within 0.07 m of the presentation point (0.09, 0.05, 0.24) at a moment when the part moves faster than 0.015 m/s.; overlapping_grips: both grippers grip the part at the same time (both fingers of each hand in contact with it) while the part moves faster than `handover_speed` = 0.04 m/s, for 0.08 s without interruption.; donor_release: the right gripper grips the part (both fingers in contact), no left-arm finger touches the part, the left gripper is open wider than 0.065 m (sum of its two finger positions), and the part moves faster than `handover_speed` = 0.04 m/s, all for 0.12 s without interruption. The release itself must happen in motion: the part's speed at the last step in this phase at which a left-arm finger touched it must have been above 0.04 m/s.; receiver_slot_delivery: the part lies in the moving slot, and the slot moves along its rail faster than 0.02 m/s, for 0.7 s without interruption. The part touches the slot, and neither gripper grips it (a single finger may still touch it). The part must have been let go into a moving slot: at the last step in this phase at which a right-arm finger touched the part, the slot moved along its rail faster than `release_slot_speed` = 0.02 m/s. In the slot's frame its centre is within 0.014 m of the slot centre along x (the slot's long axis), within 0.045 m along y, and between 0.01 m and 0.06 m above the slot floor. It moves at less than 0.05 m/s relative to the slot. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Presentation point (0.09, 0.05, 0.24) for the part's centre (moving_presentation). Lift height: part centre above z = 0.21 m (moving_pickup). Drop limit: part centre must stay at or above z = 0.13 m during moving_presentation, overlapping_grips and donor_release.
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where the task has succeeded (every phase in order) or failed (a failure event, a forbidden contact, a safety-limit violation, an object out of bounds, or the task's horizon of 25 s of simulated time, 2500 control steps), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
